exact.低伤害、真有用。先减速、再做标记，让后续火力不白打。: Low damage, high value. Slow them, mark them, and make the follow-up fire count.
exact.盯拥挤节点做小范围压制，适合补 runners 的节奏。: Suppresses crowded nodes in a small radius. Good for catching runners' timing.
exact.短命，但能把最危险的一波先钉住。: Short-lived, but it can pin the most dangerous wave first.
exact.守 choke 的硬桩。打得不算快，但会把目标往回推。: A hard pylon on the choke. It does not hit fast, but it pushes targets back.
exact.没什么花活，就是会把前排磨薄。: No tricks — it just wears the front line thin.
exact.速度快，前排空了就很容易直接穿线。: Fast. If the front is empty, it slips the line with ease.
exact.带甲推进单位，适合让剪手和集火去处理。: Armored pusher. Leave it to the snippers and focused fire.

exact.重型精英，既吃拦口又会对完整度造成更重创伤。: A heavy elite: it eats block and deals heavier integrity wounds.
